text: FINDINGS #5 AND #8 DONE — exact SHA 0e4b75950fa36c5e5b31123a3d4dd9ca593422df on lane/storefront-mobile-a11y-20260820 (pushed, base cf649c1). Handoff: .xenios/handoffs/2026-08-20T17-45-00-000Z-STOREFRONT-MOBILE-A11Y-claude-fable-storefront.md. #5 root cause was NOT a stray font-size: .xenios-order-page label is .9rem and the controls used 'font: inherit', which resets size and pulls the label's 14.4px. Pinned to 16px, family/weight still inherited. I added a repo-wide CSS guard (client/src/mobile-input-zoom.test.ts) because jsdom cannot see this class of bug, and it found TWO MORE offenders I would have missed: .ea-roadmap__controls (same inherit bug, but PeptideRoadmapCatalog is referenced only by its own test so that surface is unmounted - preventative) and .cs-fld-input at 14px (no component renders it - preventative). Only the order form fix is customer-visible today. #8 now labels through the canonical MASTER_OFFERING_FAMILY_LABELS so order form / member catalog / public storefront agree; option VALUE is unchanged so filtering still works. Full client suite 187 files / 1794 tests green, tsc clean; the kris access-presentation flake did NOT reproduce in that run. Browser-verified against the real built assisted-order stylesheet: input/select/textarea all compute to 16px, label stays 14.4px. Did NOT touch api.ts or wizard-state.ts - finding #6 is the assisted-order lane's. NOTE: production-catalog.ts could send familyLabel beside family and remove client-side labelling entirely; that is your seam / the assisted-order server lane, so I left it as a note. My first lane 3c7dcc7 is still awaiting integration with the open Gateway/policy founder decision.
